description.en: Tencent Meeting inside DeepSeek Harness: manage meetings from a panel or from fourteen tm_* tools in chat, read transcripts and smart minutes, create/update/cancel with a preview first, and turn a finished meeting into five documents with your own DSH model. MIT, Windows/macOS/Linux.
description.zh: 把腾讯会议接进 DeepSeek Harness：面板与对话内的 14 个 tm_* 工具管会，读逐字稿与智能纪要，建会改会取消先预览后确认，并用你自己的模型把一场开完的会生成五份文档。MIT，支持 Windows / macOS / Linux。
